title: Add as numbers, not text
prompt: Both values arrive as text, like "2" and "3". Return their sum as a number, 5, not the joined text "23".
starter:
func solve(a, b):
	return a + b
hints: Plus on two strings joins them; convert both first.

docs.name: int(value)
docs.what: Returns the value as a whole number; decimals are dropped, text like "42" is read.

solution:
func solve(a, b):
	return int(a) + int(b)
